plan.title: Case vs control whole-blood DE with effect-size gating
plan.analytical_narrative:
The input is a single Salmon-derived gene-level count matrix (12,000 genes x 121 columns: gene symbol + 120 samples) with a 120-row metadata table carrying one condition column, 60 cases vs 60 controls, human whole blood, unpaired, single batch. The research question has two parts: which genes differ, and which of those differences are large enough to matter. Both parts drive the design.

Because each group holds 60 samples — far above the 50-per-group threshold at which negative-binomial models (DESeq2, edgeR) have been shown to exaggerate false positives on human population cohorts (Li et al. 2022, Genome Biol 23:79) — the test is limma-voom with a fixed-effects linear model on TMM-normalized, filterByExpr-filtered counts, with a Wilcoxon rank-sum test on log-CPM as an independent control. Concordance between the two is reported explicitly; genes called only by voom are flagged as lower-confidence.

The 'large enough to matter' half is not a post-hoc filter on the fold change. At n=60 per group the test has power to call biologically trivial differences, and selecting on an estimated fold change after a zero-null test keeps the noisiest estimates and gives no FDR control for the threshold question. The plan therefore runs TREAT (treat/topTreat in limma) against an explicit |log2FC| >= 0.585 (1.5-fold) threshold as a second, separately-FDR-controlled test, and the final gene table carries both the zero-null result and the threshold result side by side, with confidence intervals on the log2 fold change.

T1S1 establishes sample structure before any test: library sizes, blind VST, PCA on the top 500 variable genes, sample-distance heatmap — the single-batch claim in the profile is a metadata assertion, and this step is where a hidden structure would show. T1S2 is the DE test itself. T1S3 is the effect-size layer plus the report, including the p-value histogram as a fit diagnostic. No enrichment step is planned: the question asks for genes and their effect sizes, not pathways, and adding enrichment would be unasked scope.

steps.method: Sample structure QC: vst(blind), PCA, sample distances, library sizes
Fixed-effects design ~condition with explicit reference level control
limma-voom with a fixed-effects linear model
Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate with TREAT against an lfc threshold
Effect-size-aware DE report with fit diagnostics and reproducibility record
